Recorded claim:
Bug 1898206 made the internal about:glean debugging page discoverable from Troubleshooting Information. The link row is marked no-copy, uses an FTL label, and opens about:glean in a new tab. Current code retains it. When adding navigation or action controls to the support page, use no-copy when their text is not diagnostic data so copied reports stay useful.

Provenance: acf7518814b466d4bdfed7eab3260769fe945b40d1554941454f9054ef2a528d.
